launches.title: Ventura - AI Teammates for Industrial Distributors
launches.tagline: We automate quoting and order processing. Distributors win more business.
launches.detail_body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Jack](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackmpcollins) and [Swen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/swenkoller/) - cofounders of [Ventura](https://www.ventura.ai) 👋

**TL;DR**

Industrial distributors spend billions of dollars a year on inside sales teams whose primary job is manually typing quotes and orders into ERPs. Ventura automates that work. Reps go from doing data entry to approving AI-generated quotes. Response times drop from hours to minutes, and distributors win more business.

<https://youtu.be/eKK1mMQ6_Ss>

**❌ The Problem**

Industrial distribution is an $8 trillion industry. It keeps the construction industry supplied and factories running. But the tools running it haven't kept up.

A typical distributor gets hundreds of quote and order requests every day - over email, PDF, Excel, handwritten fax, and phone. Every one has to be manually read, interpreted, and typed into the ERP. By a human.

The numbers:

* One distributor we work with processes more than 1M quotes and sales orders per year, almost entirely by hand
* 35% of B2B deals go to whoever responds first
* One of our customers estimates the delay costs them millions in lost deals every year

The best salespeople in the industry spend their days on data entry instead of selling.

**✅ The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98814&key=user_uploads/490571/c00a0929-5c5a-46e6-81e6-6021bb6f1f0e)

Ventura plugs into the ERP distributors already run on. Most customers are live within days. Ventura interprets the incoming request, drafts a quote or order, and provides an interface for reps to review Ventura’s output. The result then gets submitted to the ERP.

Two things customers love about Ventura:

* **It learns about your customers and products.** A distributor might carry 150 types of nails. When a buyer writes "the usual nails," Ventura goes back through that customer's email history and makes a judgment call on the right SKU. And it gets sharper with every example, just like a smart teammate.
* **You can teach it new skills and processes.** We start with quoting and order entry. One customer then taught Ventura to convert construction spec sheets into material lists by writing down exactly how their best rep handles it. That task - previously 30 minutes per document - now takes seconds. Any workflow your team does repeatedly can become a Ventura skill.

**👋 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98814&key=user_uploads/490571/920c9dc4-5f6c-4f68-bc51-eb8302bda77d)

Swen (CEO) — Advised steel, cement, and industrial machinery manufacturers as a consultant at BCG, then co-founded and exited a process automation platform for European wholesale distributors. While doing his MBA at Harvard, he embedded with a $2bn distributor to build their AI sales automation from scratch. That became Ventura.

Jack (CTO) — Has been building with AI Language Models since before they became large. Founding Engineer at Develop Health, where he automated back-office operations in healthcare with AI - the same class of problems we're solving for distributors. The company scaled from zero to $7M ARR in 14 months with a team of 5.

🤝 **Our Ask**

Are you a distributor or manufacturer with a large inside sales or customer service team? We'd love to show you what Ventura can do.

📧 Reach out: [founders@ventura.ai](mailto:founders@ventura.ai)

🌐 Request a demo: [www.ventura.ai](http://www.ventura.ai)

launches.title: Voltair: Network of Distributed Autonomous Drones for Earth observation
launches.tagline: Critical Information On-Demand
launches.detail_body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98780&key=user_uploads/2807951/942fe394-9295-4ee8-9b6d-979e050426c9)

Voltair is building the worlds first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. [https://voltairlabs.com](https://voltairlabs.com/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98780&key=user_uploads/2807951/5399af3e-19c1-4497-82da-618f72aa149f)

Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98780&key=user_uploads/2807951/68775f10-3f09-4b72-95fb-323fb497b334)

With a charging network deployed on the power grid, Voltair can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98780&key=user_uploads/2807951/b2b86f38-c0de-4bd6-8ff2-ceb51eeed45c)

Voltair envisions a future in which drone instances are requested on-demand through the platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.

launches.title: GladeKit: AI agent for game development
launches.tagline: AI agent that understands your Unity project and builds directly inside it (Unreal Engine next)
launches.detail_body:
GladeKit is an AI agent that understands your Unity project and can create systems, modify scenes, and fix bugs directly inside your engine. It doesn’t just generate code snippets - it takes direct action inside your project.

**Demo**: <https://youtu.be/nzyCk8rsrdw?si=nfMdivnegZ0R94tW>

# **The problem**

Most AI tools for game development don’t see your scene hierarchy, prefabs, or existing systems, so developers end up copying code into Unity, wiring components together, fixing errors, and repeating the process.

This constant context switching slows down shipping real gameplay.

# **The solution: an engine-aware AI agent**

GladeKit connects directly to your Unity project and understands the full context of your game. It reads your scripts, assets, scene hierarchy, and components, then plans and executes changes directly inside the engine.

What that looks like in practice:

* 150+ native Unity actions: create prefabs, wire up Animator Controllers, configure physics, build UI, set up lighting, bake NavMeshes - all from natural language
* Full project awareness: the AI sees your scene hierarchy, active errors, render pipeline, selected objects, and script content before it does anything
* Three modes built for different workflows: Agent, Debug, and Ask
* Turn-by-turn revert: every change the AI makes is tracked and reversible, with a built-in script diff viewer so you see exactly what changed

You describe what you want, and GladeKit builds it inside your project.

# **How it works**

GladeKit indexes your Unity project and builds a structured understanding of:

• Scripts and APIs

• Scene hierarchy and GameObjects

• Prefabs, assets, and components

When you request a change (for example: “Create a player controller with WASD movement” or “Fix this null reference error”), it generates a plan and applies the required changes directly to the project.

# **The ask**

1. If you’re building a game in Unity, we’d love for you to try GladeKit.
2. If you know indie studios or teams experimenting with AI dev tools, intros would be hugely appreciated.

Try it for free here:

<https://www.gladekit.com>

launches.title: Spine Swarm: Your AI Team for Everything Beyond Code
launches.tagline: Spine gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas to complete complex projects: research, analysis, financial models, prototypes, decks, and more.
launches.detail_body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Spine Swarm.

**TL;DR**

You describe a project. A team of AI agents spins up, works in parallel on a visual canvas, and delivers finished outputs: market reports, financial models, slide decks, interactive prototypes. Free to get started, no setup needed.

**Ask:** Sign up and try it at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai). We'd love to hear what you build — drop us a note at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai).

<https://youtu.be/vylx9rzC388>

## **❌ The Problem**

AI agents for coding have crossed a threshold. Tools like Cursor and Claude Code let engineers describe a project and come back to finished, working code. That experience doesn't exist yet for the rest of the work that drives a company forward.

As coding gets increasingly automated, the bottleneck is moving upstream: strategy documents, competitive analysis, financial modeling, sales collateral, market research, SEO audits, rapid prototyping. These are multi-hour, multi-step projects that require pulling information from many sources, structuring it, and producing polished output.

Today's AI tools treat this kind of work as a conversation. You get a chat thread, local file management, and one model doing everything sequentially. For simple tasks that works fine. But for complex projects, the single-chat paradigm breaks down. You end up managing the AI instead of letting it manage the work.

We've been building at this intersection for 3 years. Last year we launched Spine Canvas, a visual workspace for orchestrating AI models. Swarm is the next step: the canvas now has autonomous agents that can take on entire projects from start to finish.

## **🛠 Our Solution**

Spine Swarm gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas. You describe the project, and Spine spins up specialized agents in parallel, each handling a different part of the work. You can watch them execute in real time, inspect each artifact as it's created, and edit anything in place.

* **Multi-agent execution:** Spine orchestrates a team of agents across your project. For a competitive analysis, one agent researches market data, another structures the findings, another builds the slide deck. They work simultaneously, not sequentially, and can run autonomously for 80+ minutes on large projects.
* **Intelligent model selection:** We route between 300+ models, picking the best one for each step and ensembling multiple models to override any single model's biases. You don't configure any of this.
* **Visual canvas:** Every artifact your agents produce appears on a shared canvas where you can inspect, compare, edit, and branch. No chat windows, no file systems.

Everything Spine builds is downloadable and hosted at a shareable link. Just send your team the URL.

## **📊 Why This Works**

A common question we hear: "You're using the same models everyone else has access to. Why would the output be better?"

We recently scored **87.6% on Google DeepMind's DeepSearchQA**, a benchmark that measures how well AI answers complex research questions requiring multi-step reasoning across sources:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98705&key=user_uploads/1362282/fb8a5039-8780-455d-abc4-7f3da613aa7b)

Three things drive this:

* **Model routing and ensembling:** Spine selects the best model from 300+ options for each step and ensembles multiple models to override any single model's biases or blind spots.
* **Orchestration:** How you decompose a complex task, coordinate agents across steps, and manage handoffs between them matters as much as the models themselves.
* **Intelligent canvas:** Agents work on a shared canvas where they can read each other's outputs, build on previous steps, and assemble coherent deliverables. This also means every step is fully auditable, so you can trace how agents arrived at their conclusions and verify their reasoning.

Read more about our approach and the full benchmark results[ on our blog](https://blog.getspine.ai/spine-swarm-hits-1-on-gaia-level-3-and-google-deepmind-deepsearchqa/).

## **🚀 Tasks Worth Trying**

* "_Audit \[your website URL\] and produce a full SEO analysis, competitive landscape, and a prioritized growth roadmap with a slide deck._" You'll see agents browsing your site, researching competitors, and assembling deliverables simultaneously.
* "_I'm preparing to fundraise. Here are my company details: \[paste\]. Build me a pitch deck, competitive landscape with market sizing, a financial model, and personalized outreach emails for target investors._"
* "_Here's a product idea: \[describe it\]. Generate three different interactive prototypes and landing pages exploring different design directions, alongside a PRD and go-to-market strategy._"

## **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Try it:** Sign up at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai) and run one of the tasks above. It's free to get started, no credit card required.
* **Tell us what you build:** We're actively shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email us at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai) with what you tried and how it went.

**Share this post** if you know founders, operators, or team leads drowning in the strategic and analytical work that's piling up as code writes itself.

launches.title: Mango Medical: Taking the guesswork out of orthopedic surgeries with agentic planning
launches.tagline: Surgery planning takes specialized engineering teams multiple business days - Mango Medical does it in seconds.
launches.detail_body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Adrian and Jorge, co-founders of Mango Medical Inc.

**TL;DR: Mango Medical builds AI Agents that take CT scans and X-Rays and plan which implant sizes and approach works.**

Instead of waiting for specialized planning engineering teams to turn-around a plan over multiple business days, orthopedic implant companies work with our APIs to submit the CT scan of a patient and receive a full surgical plan within seconds, starting with shoulder replacement surgeries.\
\
Our launch video: <https://youtu.be/mjmshBnjOBk>\
\
👉 **Ask**: If you know orthopedic surgeons and orthopedic implant companies that have surgical planning needs, we'd love to partner with them to give them instant planning tools via API and give us early feedback on our upcoming planning product.\
Send them to <https://mangomedical.com> or reach out to [founders@mangomedical.io](mailto:founders@mangomedical.io). \
\
**The Problem**

30 million orthopedic surgeries are conducted every year, that all receive some form of medical imaging prior to surgery. \
Roughly 10 million of those are joint replacement surgeries that receive planning over 2 - 5 business days. This limits the use of robots and 3D printed guide systems and adds time and interruptions between when a surgeon sees the patient and when the plan can be discussed with the patient. \
\
15 million surgeries are acute fractures. Time-sensitive surgeries of high complexity, that have the same source medical imaging data, but lack the planning workflows to plan outcomes and take the cognitive load off of the surgeons. \
\
They have to figure out how to treat their patient during the surgery, which leads to a lot of trial and error, wasted operating room time, wrong implants, complications and revision surgeries. The number 1 request from surgeons we have received was for them to be able to have patient-specific plans for these complex cases.\
\
When surgeries become plannable instantly, it opens the door to planning multiple scenarios and giving surgeons peace of mind that they know how to face the surgery they are entering in the operating room.

\*\*When planning can be done instantaneously, all surgeries can be planned in time.\*\*\
\
**The Team**

**Adrian Kilian** (CEO): Dentist and maxillofacial surgery researcher, Stanford GSB Ignite Allumni, former voice actor.

**Jorge Padilla Perez** (CTO): Contributed to the original U-NET paper and collaborated with ETH Zurich, Stanford, University of Augsburg, and TU Munich in his research on medical imaging.

launches.tagline: Beginning with physician scheduling and care coordination
launches.detail_body:
Hey YC! We’re Ab, Sam and Zac.

**We are building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations, beginning with physician scheduling and care coordination, to combat rampant inefficiencies in healthcare.**

**Our Beginning:**

This all began when a doctor at Johns Hopkins told us that residents and attending physicians spend **hundreds of hours** each year scheduling. Thus began our **physician** **scheduling service**. 

We built an internal **Optimization Programming Language** that lets us create complex schedules far faster than traditional methods. Our clients now review schedules we build, rather than spend hundreds of hours manually creating them.

Through our scheduling, we have built trust in healthcare logistics across major academic health systems with active contracts at **Mass General**, **Johns Hopkins**, **UT Southwestern**, **LA General**, **UCF** and more! We are actively growing and onboarding new partners.

**Revelations I:**

These relationships revealed that healthcare administration, more generally, is unbelievably manual, disjointed, and inefficient. That’s why we have expanded our scope to tackle clinical care coordination. We have separated clinic operations into two segments: **The Patients**, and **The Resources**. 

**The Patients:**

The patient journey at most clinics begins with a referral process that leads to a triaging bottleneck before a patient can be seen. Only once this is complete can the complex systems for evaluation and treatment tracking begin.

**The Resources:**

Managing and tracking personnel, rooms, and time is difficult for even the best administrative teams.

**The Secret**

The problem with healthcare is not on the demand side, it is on the supply side. **Care coordination is the bridge between patient needs and hospital resources.**

**Revelations II:**

With our design partners at **UCSF and other major healthcare systems**, we are building patient triaging and provider management systems to improve and automate care coordination, while reducing administrative burden.

We aim to modernize healthcare operations. As our partnerships grow and our scope expands, we will become the key player in **bringing healthcare operations into the future.**

**The Team**

We are a team of award-winning mathematicians, computer scientists, and logistics experts from Johns Hopkins University.\
\
Our CEO, **Sam Oberly**, is an expert in predictive logistics with a civilian service medal for his logistical coordination algorithm development. He is a published mathematician, trained at Hopkins and Cambridge. (<https://www.linkedin.com/in/sam-oberly/>)

Our CTO, **Abdelrahman Hamimi**, is an AWS certified cloud solutions architect who built internal automation software at GEICO used internally across multiple departments. He graduated from Hopkins with an MS and a BS in computer science, and a BA in Economics. His entire immediate family are all doctors. (<https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdelrahman-hamimi-2064ab202/>)

Our COO, **Zachary Dermody**, has boots-on-the-ground experience in logistics management at Amazon and McMaster-Carr. He studied economics and computer science at Hopkins, and his mother is a practicing physician. (<https://www.linkedin.com/in/zachary-dermody-41238a202/>)

**Reach us at [founders@schedulingwiz.com](mailto:founders@schedulingwiz.com)**

launches.title: Rubric AI
launches.tagline: Reasoning and Verification for AI Agents
launches.detail_body:
Hi YC! 👋 

I’m Pragya, co-founder of Rubric AI. 

**Tl;dr:**

Rubric AI is building the human and computational layer that turns expert judgment into training signals for frontier models and agents. We believe that shaping the world's most consequential AI systems requires both purpose-built training environments and exceptional judgment.

**Launch Video:**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_9EzHGu5y5E>

**The Problem** 

There are now over 10,000 vertical AI companies deploying in specialized domains. They all face the same problem: generalist models can't reliably handle high-stakes, judgment-heavy work. While AI agents look impressive in demos, they frequently fail at runtime by selecting the wrong tools, failing to verify steps, or lacking the ability to recover from errors. These companies need their agents to reason and execute like domain experts, but the infrastructure to make that happen doesn't exist.

**The Solution** 

Rubric builds runtime reasoning infrastructure that turns expert judgment into training signals for frontier models and agents. We build purpose-built reasoning environments, curate expert-verified reasoning traces, and plug in at test time to guide agents on how to reason, when they select tools, how they verify intermediate steps, and when they must escalate to a human, turning generalist agents into domain specialists.

**The Team** 

Our co-founder Pragya has spent the last decade building complex products from scratch and scaling them. launches.detail_body:
In just 6 weeks, GRU Space built the world’s first [Moon Factory](https://youtu.be/k9X7TuAxNrw) for under $5,000. GRU’s patent-pending prototype autonomously:

launches.title: HLabs: US-made robot actuators and electronics
launches.tagline: An ecosystem of US-made plug and play parts to build robots
launches.detail_body:
Hi, I’m Paul the Founder of HLabs and we’re making what you need to get a robot to move. \
\
**TL;DR**\
HLabs is an ecosystem of US-made plug and play parts to build robots; an Nvidia Jetson companion board, 2-channel wireless module, FOC control boards, motors and actuators. With HLabs no time is wasted getting things to work. You can focus on what matters. Our launch sale is live right now at [hlaboratories.com](https://hlaboratories.com)\
\
**Most robots look like college projects**\
Right now to make a robot you have to stitch together a bunch of different PCBs with jumper cables and wait weeks for blackbox actuators to arrive from China.\
You spend lots of time debugging why your CAN bus isn’t working, why every actuator performs differently, and meanwhile your wires keep coming loose.\
\
You say that you’ll design your own PCBs and controllers to bring everything together but you keep putting it back because something else more important keeps coming up.\
\
These problems plague bigger companies too and add a huge amount of additional time to projects. On top of this there’s huge unpredictability in geopolitics and supply chains when sourcing from overseas.\
\
**It doesn’t have to be this way**\
HLabs is making a plug-and-play ecosystem for everything that you need to build a robot. We’re starting with:

* RB1 - A robot main board powered by an Nvidia Jetson. This handles power distribution, compute, and a bunch more.
* WM1 - 2-channel wireless radio for sending video/data making the RB1 remotely controllable over USB-C.
* M1 - A pancake motor.
* ACB3 - An FOC control board with matching connectors to the RB1.
* A1/A1m - A planetary/cycloidal actuator powered by the ACB3.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98674&key=user_uploads/316612/b61549b8-41f6-4ec5-be50-30d521a92762)

These products abstract away all of the complexity in designing and controlling a robot's electronics. Complicated communication interfaces are replaced with simple python libraries. You can now focus on getting your robot to walk instead of turning on reliably.

Our focus is on working with startups building medium to large size robots like quadrupeds, humanoids, and robot arms!\
\
\*\*There’s a launch sale on right now!\*\*\
Everything is up for preorder right now with the electronics shipping this summer, and the M1 shipping in the next 1-2 months. You can place an order on our store here while the sale last for this week:

<https://hlaboratories.com>

Thanks!

launches.title: Beyond Agents: The Era of AI Employees
launches.tagline: Trusted from Fortune 500s to Governments
launches.detail_body:
Today, StackAI is launching three capabilities that are ushering in the era of AI employees: computer use, access to the web, and the ability to coordinate as a team. Each one is a breakthrough on its own; together, they represent a fundamental shift in what enterprise AI can do.

+++

We’ve moved from AI that responds, to AI that reasons, to AI that acts. Now we’re entering the next stage: AI that works like an employee you onboard. That starts with the same thing you’d give any new team member on day one: a computer, access to your internal tools, and a team to work with.

1. **Giving Every AI Agent a Computer**

Computer use gives each AI agent a sandboxed environment where it can execute commands, run scripts, read and write files, send emails, post Slack messages, and work across the tools your enterprise already uses. Think of it like Claude Code, but living inside StackAI and securely connected to everything your organization already uses.

Video: <https://youtu.be/6fvLqfvqsDg>

Computer Use on StackAI doesn’t just suggest, it reads your repo, runs commands, edits files, and iterates until the job is done. Need a comprehensive performance deck? The agent navigates to your analytics platform, pulls the numbers, builds the charts, then formats everything into a clean, ready-to-share deck and forwards it to your team. Professional output. Zero manual effort. You don’t even have to press send.

These agents reason about what needs to happen, adapt when things change, and find a path to the output regardless of what gets in the way.

**What it Means for Enterprises**

Every knowledge worker spends a significant portion of their time on coordination, data gathering, and repetitive execution. Computer use agents absorb that entire layer, freeing your team to focus on the nuanced work that actually requires human judgment.

2. **Navigating the Web Like a Human Employee**

A huge portion of enterprise work doesn’t happen inside your internal stack. It happens on the web: in vendor portals, legacy systems, government databases, and SaaS platforms that predate modern APIs.

Video: <https://youtu.be/JKyN2mYj72A>

Browser use gives AI agents the ability to navigate the web the way a human does—not through an API or pre-built connector, but by seeing a page, understanding what’s on it, and interacting with it. Clicking, filling forms, logging in, extracting data, submitting inputs. For an agent with browser use, every website is a potential integration; every legacy system, regardless of age or architecture, becomes part of the automation surface.

**What it Means for Enterprises**

Traditional automation has always had a hard boundary: no API, no integration. Enterprises worked around this by having humans manually bridge the gaps. 

But now, an AI employee can log into your logistics vendor’s portal, pull open order status, and update your internal tracking system without anyone touching it. It can monitor competitor pricing across a dozen sites and flag changes before your next pricing review. It can navigate regulatory databases, extract relevant filings, and route them to your compliance team.

Anything a human can do in a browser, an AI employee can do too, including the long tail of irregular, one-off tasks that are too infrequent to build traditional automation around but too time-consuming to keep handing to people.

3. **Coordinating at Scale with Sub-Agent Teams**

Computer use gives AI agents a workstation. Browser use gives them reach across the web. But there’s a ceiling to what any single agent, or any single AI employee, can do alone.

A sub-agent workflow has a manager and a team. The orchestrator agent receives a high-level objective, breaks it into component tasks, delegates each to a specialized sub-agent, reviews the outputs, and synthesizes everything into a final deliverable. Each sub-agent maintains its own context window, so the system handles complex tasks without the constraints that limit a single model.

Take a market intelligence agent. A single agent would need to research competitors, extract financial data, analyze trends, and write everything up sequentially, based on the user’s request. A multi-agent team handles it differently: the orchestrator delegates research to one agent, data extraction to another, analysis to a third, writing to a fourth. Sub-agents may or may not be called upon depending on the original task. The result is one polished deliverable, produced in a fraction of the time.

## **The Era of AI Employees Is Here**

Multi-agent architectures on StackAI let you build workflows that match the actual complexity of your business, not simplified versions of it. 

The era of AI employees is here! Ready to put them to work? 

**Get started with StackAI → [stack-ai.com/demo](http://stack-ai.com/demo)**

launches.title: Zatanna | APIs for AI agents
launches.tagline: Zatanna creates faster, cheaper, and more reliable APIs for AI agents
launches.detail_body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Rithvik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rithvik-vanga-0824a5225/), [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-blackwell-506228206/), and [Tarun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tarunvedula/), the team behind [Zatanna](https://www.linkedin.com/company/usezatanna/).

**TL;DR:** Today, most AI companies rely on slow, brittle, and unreliable computer-use agents to interact with software that has no API.  Zatanna solves this with faster, cheaper, and more reliable APIs for AI agents by reverse engineering requests and taking care of antibot infrastructure. 

[Video Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HUCOKVn-atM)

**The Problem:**

A huge amount of valuable business software still has no usable API. So when AI companies need their agents to interact with ERPs, PMS systems, portals, marketplaces, or other operational websites, they often fall back to browser automation.

That means the agent is stuck looking at screens, clicking buttons, waiting for pages to load, dealing with logins, handling UI changes, and breaking every time the workflow shifts. It is fine for showing that something is possible. It is terrible when the workflow actually matters.

Teams end up spending an absurd amount of engineering time maintaining brittle browser automations instead of building product and serving customers.

**The Solution:**

Zatanna runs these workflows at the request layer.

We observe how a workflow works once, reconstruct the underlying request sequence, and host it as a clean API that any agent can call. Instead of navigating a browser, the agent just hits an endpoint.

That makes the workflow:

* faster
* cheaper
* more reliable
* much easier to maintain at scale

We also handle the painful infrastructure required to keep these workflows alive in production:

* session and credential management
* request sequencing
* proxy networks and traffic distribution
* retries, monitoring, and recovery

Today we’re already supporting customers where either throughput or reliability is mission-critical, from high-volume consumer platforms to operationally sensitive industries like logistics.

**Where we’re seeing this most:**

* ERPs like SAP
* PMS / POS systems
* insurance/benefits/claims portals
* marketplaces(checkout flows)
* operational websites with no APIs
* basically anywhere the current solution is scraping or browser automation

**Why we’re doing this:**

We started in vertical AI and ran into this problem ourselves. The model layer kept getting easier. Software access was the real bottleneck. A huge amount of engineering effort went into keeping integrations alive instead of improving the actual agent.

So we decided to build the thing we wished we had.

**What we’re looking for:**

If you’re building something that depends on browser automation or computer-use agents for integrations, especially where reliability, speed, or cost matter, we’d love to take a look at the workflow.

Book a call [here](https://zatanna.cal.com/tarun/30min?user=tarun&overlayCalendar=true) or email [**tarun@zatanna.ai**](mailto:tarun@zatanna.ai)

If you know any **Chief Compliance Officers, Heads of Compliance, General Counsel, Operations Leaders, or Founders** at companies in debt collection, lending, mortgage, insurance, money transmission, digital assets, or other regulated industries that need help getting licensed across jurisdictions and managing ongoing compliance, we would love to talk at [founders@payna.com](https://payna.com)!

launches.title: Palus Finance - Better yields on idle cash for startups and SMBs
launches.tagline: Up to 50% more yield from your company treasury, without switching banks.
launches.detail_body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Sam and Michael, co-founders of Palus Finance.

**TL;DR: Palus gives startups and SMBs access to institutional-grade bond portfolios, earning up to 50% more yields than money market funds with comparable safety and near-immediate liquidity.**

Instead of replacing your bank, we plug into it, so you can spend five minutes optimizing your treasury and get back to building.

👉 **Ask**: If your startup has idle cash earning money market rates, we'd love to show you what you're leaving on the table. Sign up at[ ](https://palus.finance/)[palus.finance](http://palus.finance) or reach out at [founders@palus.finance](mailto:founders@palus.finance).

Our launch video: <https://youtu.be/tOXypVV3Czc> 

### **The Problem**

After a fundraise, startups park 18–24 months of cash in a money market fund and draw it down gradually. That cash sits there for months or years, earning roughly 3.5%, because every existing treasury product does the same thing: sweep your cash into a money market fund and charge a management fee.

Money market funds are the lowest rung of what's available in fixed income. They're safe and liquid, but you're paying for same-day liquidity on cash you won't touch for six months. Fortune 500 companies don't do this; they have treasury teams that actively invest in a range of safe, higher-yielding assets. But those strategies have always required dedicated treasury operations, and founders don't have time to be portfolio managers.

It turns out, a good yield strategy can have a real impact. On a $10M balance, the difference between 3.5% and 5% is $150K per year.

**That can mean an extra engineer. Less dilution for founders. Or if it comes down to it, weeks of extra runway that can literally save your company.**

That kind of impact is worth five minutes of your time. We make it that quick.

### **The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98654&key=user_uploads/3161967/8b564aea-e38b-400c-90c3-9a668224f055)

Palus replaces the default money market fund with a bond portfolio specifically optimized for startup treasuries, targeting 4.5–5% returns with equivalent safety and 1–2 day withdrawal times. In other words, by giving up a couple days of liquidity on cash you won’t need for months, you can get up to 50% more yield on your treasury.

We're the only startup treasury product with a differentiated investment strategy. Everyone else is just a wrapper on a money market fund.

We think that startup banking products themselves (Brex, Mercury, etc.) are genuinely great at what they do: payments, payroll, card management. But it turns out their great bank product is bundled with a crappy treasury one. So rather than building another neobank, we built Palus to connect to your existing bank account via Plaid. Our goal was to create the simplest possible UX for this product: two buttons and a number that goes up.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98654&key=user_uploads/3161967/af23849b-56c1-46a0-b3ad-a5f6d6247f60)

_Yes, this is what it actually looks like._

## **The Backstory**

When we joined YC, like all our peers, we were bombarded by emails from every startup bank, asking us to put money in their treasury platform. But then we realized all these products are just some elegant branding on a money market fund.

Sam comes from a finance background, so the status quo felt strange: startups were defaulting into the lowest-yielding safe asset in fixed income, simply because no one had built an easy way for them to access anything better (there is actually one widely-advertised treasury product that claims to offer higher yields, but instead of an MMF it uses a mutual fund where your principal is at considerable risk; it had a 9% loss in 2022 that took years to recover).

And it's personal. We’ve seen friends’ startups try to stretch every last dollar of runway, hoping to buy just a few more weeks to close a round. A better yield on their reserves could have given them breathing room when it mattered most. That's the kind of margin we're building for.

So after talking to hundreds of founders, our mission was clear: create something that lets them easily access institutional-grade yields, so they can focus on building.

### **The Ask**

**If your startup has cash sitting in a money market fund**, sign up at[ ](https://palus.finance/)[palus.finance](http://palus.finance) and see how much more you could be earning. Setup takes minutes.

**Know a founder or CFO managing idle cash?** Send them our way: [founders@palus.finance](mailto:founders@palus.finance).

Reach out if you have any questions: we love talking about this stuff, helping founders manage their money, and making finance less confusing for people.

### **The Team**

**Sam Lushtak** (CEO): Previously built an investment research platform for an asset manager with over $3T AUM. Caltech alum. Sharpe ratio enthusiast.

**Michael Gonzalez** (CTO): Wrote monitoring software that saved defense contractors $150M+ by optimizing uptime of multi-site quantum computing fleets. Caltech alum. Distributed systems nerd.

**See Palus in action here:** <https://youtu.be/8Q_gwSqtnxM>

_This post is for educational purposes only and does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Yields and spreads referenced are approximate and based on historical data._
